mapper.sql: select distinct u.user_id as "userId", k.staff_no as "staffNo", k.staff_name as "staffName", k.organization_code as "organizationCode", k.position_name as "positionName", k.job_grade as "jobGrade", k.employment_status as "employmentStatus", u.system_use_enabled as "systemUseEnabled", k.retirement_date as "retirementDate", k.last_synced_at as "lastSyncedAt" from user_account u join korus_staff_snapshot k on k.staff_id = u.korus_staff_id left join user_role_assignment ura on ura.user_id = u.user_id and ura.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select role_code from user_role_assignment where user_id=#{userId} and status='ACTIVE' order by role_code
mapper.update: update user_account set system_use_enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = now() where user_id = #{userId}
update user_role_assignment set status='REVOKED', updated_at=now(), processed_at=now() where user_id=#{userId} and status='ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: insert into user_role_assignment(user_id, role_code, assignment_type, valid_from, valid_to, approved_by_user_id, status) values (#{userId}, #{roleCode}, 'MANUAL', #{validFrom}, #{validTo}, #{actor}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: select count(*) from role where role_code = #{roleCode}
